notes.title: 24 April release notes
notes.notes:
Features
- NPCs now understand more phrases and expressions, and are less likely to misunderstand the player

Quality of life
- NPCs can explain why they’re doing what they’re doing in a more natural, conversational way

Bugfixes
- Fixed bug where NPCs would try and talk about things they didn’t know anything about

notes.title: 8 April release notes
notes.notes:
Features
- Added basic skills and exp gaining mechanisms: woodcutting, mining, crafting, socialising, woodcarving, smithing, magic and cooking
- Added unlockable talents that provide extra abilities to skills. This is an early stage feature, and will iterate based on feedback in play testing.
- Added a chance for tree seeds to drop when chopping a tree
- Added farms and farming as a job - NPC farmers will till earth, obtain and plant seeds, tend and water crops, and harvest and sell their produce
- NPCs can now explain why they’re doing a particular action, whether it’s part of their job or because it’s part of a broader goal they have

Quality of life
- Improved cooking UI layout and text
- Hide equipped entity when parts of UI open
- Improve on screen player messages so messages won’t be lost if they are interrupted

Bugfixes
- Fixed bug where no message was shown to player if they couldn’t use an item
- Fixed some items appearing too small in inventory
- Fixed bug where NPCs would sometimes use the player’s name in dialogue before knowing it
- Fixed bug where player dialogue that included the word ‘what’ would be interpreted as saying hello
- Fixed bug where cooking ingredients placed on cooking tools couldn’t be picked up until the tool was picked up and replaced
- Fixed bug where NPC planning would occasionally become corrupted

notes.title: 22 Feb Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed bug where NPCs sometimes wouldn't finish their current action

notes.title: 22 Feb release notes
notes.notes:
Features
- Added a world map which can be accessed by pressing [M], and can be filtered on terrain, structures, natural features and lots

Quality of life
-Updated minimap to show more useful information about the world, not just locations
- Added an unequip shortcut button which can be used by pressing [U] with an item equipped
- Transfer liquid from one container to another directly by clicking on the target
- Added more audio for cooking and general world interactions
- Improved new game world generation performance
- Minor UI tweaks

Bugfixes
- Fixed bug where NPCs would continue to try and move even when stuck
- Fixed bug that would create a warning log message every time the inventory was opened
- Fixed bug if player tried to say something while looking at an inanimate object
- Fixed bug where NPCs would try and do impossible actions

notes.title: 8 Feb release notes
notes.notes:
Features

- Added dynamic floor dependent player footsteps
- Added more audio to cooking and using items

Quality of life

- Added more early game tutorials and hints
- Reduced the likelihood of critical bugs
- Refreshed settings menu and added mouse sensitivity as an option
- Added wait screen messages and hints when a new game is starting

Bugfixes

- Stopped NPCs from asking to be unstuck when already talking to the player

notes.title: Feb 2 - Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed issues relating to different OS region settings

notes.title: 2 Feb update
notes.notes:
Features

- NPCs now have a better understanding of plurals of words (e.g. ‘cakes’ not just 'cake)
- Cooked food recipes now provide a hunger fill up based on their ingredients

Bugfixes

- Fixed bug where NPC occasionally would stop trying to understand what player has said to them
- Fixed bug which would occasionally prevent world generation from completing

notes.title: 1 Feb Update
notes.notes:
Features
- NPC dialogue now includes hobby / activity preferences
- Added seeds which have a chance of dropping each time a plant is harvested, and can be used to plant another of that plant type
- Adding prototype cooking - using a stove, cauldron or campfire the player can make some basic recipes with fruit and vegetables that can be sliced, diced, fried and boiled.
- Items can be placed on surfaces like tables or counters
- NPCs now have a much greater ability to understand the player, through identifying what they say in amongst other words, as well as being able to understand the player saying multiple things at the same time
- NPCs can now learn and remember new words from the player to a limited extent, largely synonyms (words that mean the same as other words)
- NPCs now have a very basic understanding of the world, and can answer questions about things like the sky, the earth and so on based on their knowledge - this is early stage and will improve over time
- Items with liquids (like a bucket) in now show that liquid in the world

Quality of life
- Hints and reminders for new players now appear if the game detects a player is struggling with something
- NPCs now guess what the player is saying much faster

Bugfixes
- Fixed bug where craft item particles weren’t showing when an item was crafted
- Fixed bug where world generation would fail from clothes not generating properly
- Fixed inventory items slightly offset from inventory
- Fixed bug where placing an item caused the ‘ghost’ version of the item to actually collide with real entities

notes.title: 19 Dec Update
notes.notes:
Features
- Improved NPC ability to understand what the player is saying - including references to ‘you’ and ‘me’ and talking about future actions and a few more general things to talk about

Quality of life
- Increased player walk speed to be slightly faster than NPC walk speed
- Improved world generation speed
- Added more explainers and tutorials for how to play the game
- Minor inventory and crafting ui improvements

Bugfixes
- Fixed occasional bug where time would stop
- Fixed occasional bug where NPC actions would have the wrong requirements so would fail (e.g. trying to eat a location, trying to talk to an edible entity etc)

notes.title: 16 Dec Update
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
- Added liquids - collect water from wells using buckets, bottles or anything else that can be used to hold liquids

[b]Quality of life[/b]
- Reduced number of notifications new players get when starting the game for the first time
- Improved world generation time by around 30 seconds

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Fixed bug where sometimes radial display actions didn’t activate when clicked on
- Fixed bug where UI icons sometimes wouldn’t update when items were dropped / unequipped

notes.title: 15 Dec Update
notes.notes:
Added ability for NPCs to recognise when player is asking about a person, thing or concept that doesn’t exist in the game world and respond accordingly

Added tutorial and helper text to show how to use items / interact with NPCs

Added wells for water collection - liquids functionality to come soon in a future update

Fixed bug where sometimes the world would spawn without a starting transport stop

Fixed bug where occasionally the game would start in a test scenario

Fixed bug where sometimes the player’s name would be used instead of an NPC’s name when the player learned something new about the NPC

notes.title: Minor post revamp update
notes.notes:
- Removed debug text
- Fixed main menu skip

notes.title: Update 111224
notes.notes:
We've rebuilt EverWorld from the ground up. We realised that to fulfil the interesting features and gameplay we wanted (NPCs you can talk to and that react to a fully interactable world) we needed to re-architect the base systems of EverWorld. So that's what we've done.

We've pivoted more towards the base foundations of a life sim that we can then build more and more features on. This means NPCs have jobs, will sustain themselves, will walk around etc - and we can build more that they can do on top of our systems. We've had to make the game world smaller (for now!) - but this comes with much deeper simulation and interaction.

Watch this space for further updates coming soon.

notes.title: Update 020722
notes.notes:
Content
- NPC jobs and occupations are now broadly functional:
  - Farmers will sow seeds, water and tend to their plants, and harvest their crops to sell
  - Miners will find nearby rocks and minerals to mine and sell
  - Woodcutters will go to forests they know about to chop down trees, collect the wood and sell it
  - Foragers will try and find plants to harvest and sell
  - Storekeepers will stand at their stores - and that's pretty much it for now
- Initial paths will now generate between buildings in villages
- Very early crafting foundations are now present, letting players craft from ingredients they have using recipes they know
- Hills and mountain ranges generate more naturally with proper placement of trees and houses etc
- NPCs with jobs now have knowledge of a nearby location relevant to their job e.g. woodcutters will know about a forest

Quality of life
- Navigation performance is now slightly better
- Things will spawn in slightly better and more appropriate locations (e.g buildings, trees, plants)

Bug fixes
- Things won’t spawn underwater when they’re not supposed to
- Things won't spawn on beaches when they're not supposed to
- When things are supposed to disappear / be destroyed / be consumed this will actually happen (mostly)
- Held items won't get pushed by terrain if the player collides oddly with it
- Crystals and gems will generate as treasure in treasure chests again
- Renewable resources (e.g. plants) won't disappear when they've been fully harvested anymore

notes.title: Update 260322
notes.notes:
[b]Content[/b]
More randomised plants
Added a player clock
Stores spawn with containers and some pregenerated items
Players can farm - players can till the ground and plant seeds that will grow
Players can chop down trees with hatchets
Npc farmers will plant, tend and harvest crops
Improved terrain worldgen and terrain visuals
Changes to terrain (e.g. farming) will persist

[b]Quality of life[/b]
Added item stacking
Npcs are better at aiming
Added lighting on inventory item icons
Added item values on inventory

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Fixed giant carrots
Fixed spell projectiles not appearing when spell is cast
Fixed spells sometimes generating with no projectile
Fixed spells sometimes generating with no effect
Fixed objects sometimes not getting destroyed properly
Fixed entities that could move between loaded world tiles sometimes not getting loaded / unloaded properly
Fix bug where spells sometimes wouldn't hit targets if targets were too close to the caster
Fixed bug where some container items would still show in inventory after player had stopping looking in container
Fixed equipped item duplication bug

[b]Backend[/b]
Added integration tests for common scenarios

notes.title: Update 180222
notes.notes:
Building names now shown to player after entering
Item names now shown to player when looking at an item
Items can now be dropped directly from the inventory UI
Items can be sold when in a store by dropping them from the inventory UI
Items can be bought when in a store by picking them up (and having enough gold)
Item prices now shown to player when looking at a saleable item in a store
More buff / debuff spell effect types available in random spell generation
Item descriptions are now dynamic and provide more information about items
Inventory item icons are now 3D and show the item itself
Plants now grow and can be harvested
Added procedural plant generation on top of base plant types
Fixed buff / debuff spells not showing what they target
Fixed bug where closing container with inventory button still interacted with container when inventory next opened
Fixed game time misalignment with slowed time bug
Refactored spell databases and expanded potential random generation of spells
Did a whole bunch of back-end refactoring around saving and loading that should (hopefully) not be at all visible to players
